title: A ship found sailing with nobody aboard

lines.text: In 1872, a ship was found sailing in the Atlantic, with nobody on board.
The crew of another ship spotted her between the Azores and Portugal.
She was damaged, but still seaworthy, with sails partly set.
Her cargo of 1,701 barrels of alcohol was almost untouched. There was plenty of food.
Personal belongings were left behind. But the lifeboat was gone.
Captain Briggs, his wife, their baby daughter and seven crew had vanished.
Theories range from pirates and mutiny to a giant squid.
One of the more popular ideas: alcohol fumes from the cargo scared the crew into abandoning ship.
But nobody from the Mary Celeste was ever seen again.

sources.claim: Found 4 December 1872 by the Dei Gratia between the Azores and Portugal; seaworthy with partial sail; 1,701 barrels of alcohol intact; lifeboat missing
Captain Briggs, his wife, infant daughter and seven crew never seen again; theories include alcohol fumes, mutiny, piracy, giant squid
